Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a risk management unit within the department of corrections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a risk management unit within thedepartment of corrections; and adding a new section to chapter 72.09RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is hereby created a risk management unit within thedepartment. The secretary shall appoint a risk manager to supervisethe risk management unit. (2) The risk management unit shall: (a) Identify liability and property risk that may have asignificant economic impact on the department; (b) Evaluate existing loss control programs within the department as appropriate to suggest improvements and recognize successful safetypolicies and procedures; (c) Identify new methods to eliminate or improve conditions andpractices that contribute to loss whenever practical; (d) Identify methods to assist the department to meet therequirements for insurance coverage or service; and p. 1 HB 1104 (e) Maintain loss history information for the purpose ofidentifying and analyzing risk exposures. (3) The risk management unit shall continually report its findingsto the secretary and make recommendations to the secretary on theapplication of prudent safety, security, loss prevention, and lossminimization methods so as to reduce or avoid risk or loss. (4) When carrying out its duties under this section, the riskmanagement unit may consult with the risk management division withinthe office of financial management established in RCW 43.41.300.
